blocks.text:
This day is listed as optional.

The route first takes you to Laguna Colorada. Algae and plankton turn its waters shades ranging from brown to deep red. Three species of flamingo can be seen along the shores: James's, Andean and Chilean.

Next come the high-altitude lagoons of Cañapa, Hedionda, Chiarcota and Honda, surrounded by open plateaus and habitats for local birds.

The next part of the route passes Ollagüe Volcano and then crosses the Chiguana Salt Flat. Parts of its surface are darker than those of Uyuni, which is attributed to its high sodium and potassium content.

After the excursion, return to Uyuni, transfer to the airport and fly to Peru via La Paz, completing passport formalities along the way.

On arrival, you are met and transferred to Belmond Miraflores Park. Accommodation in an Ocean View Club Junior Suite. Overnight in Lima.
